world_date_fe.note: All event indicators are global; date fixed effects absorb them completely. No event coefficient is identified in this specification.

turnover.units_note: day_sold and day_bought are counts of 25-coin lots, so coin volume is 25x the field; order-book amounts are already coins

market_size.usd_basis: on-chain TIB/USDT quote, propagated through the GP price; not independent

bazaar_history.monthly_tc_note: monthly TC is estimated by holding the year's mean price per completed auction constant; only auction counts are published monthly
